user.title: Hackable Desk Clock
user.description: Enter the clock's address and its API key. The key is at the bottom of the clock's setup page (hold BOOT for 3 seconds to open setup mode).

data_description.host: deskclock-xxxx.local or the clock's IP address
data_description.api_key: 16 characters, shown at the bottom of the setup page

zeroconf_confirm.title: Set up {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found {name} at {host}. Enter its API key, shown at the bottom of the clock's setup page (hold BOOT for 3 seconds to open setup mode).

reauth_confirm.title: New API key for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The clock rejected the saved API key (its settings may have been erased). Enter the key shown at the bottom of its setup page.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the clock. Check the address and that the clock is on your WiFi.
error.invalid_auth: The clock rejected that API key.
error.setup_mode: The clock is in setup mode. Let it rejoin your WiFi, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This clock is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That address belongs to a different clock.
